_about: How the tested set-up (90 m, GPM IMERG, pumps off, small-drain sink 0, average soil, subsidence to the event date) matched three recorded floods; from scores-2020-01-01-imerg-v7.json, scores-2021-02-20-imerg-v7.json, scores-2025-03-04-imerg-v7.json (verification/observed/make_skill.py). hit/random: 3 x 3 land window (about 270 m), cell: same land cell; random = points spread at random over DKI land with the same rule (old, unfair: a third of the reports lie outside DKI); randomDomain = all land of the grid, randomNear = land within 1 km of a report (fair baselines), ci95 = 1 km block bootstrap of hit, pNear = one-sided binomial p against randomNear, verdict better|not_better|too_few (p < 0.05 against both fair baselines, at least 100 reports); hitDki/randomDki = reports inside DKI only; legacyHit: the old rule that counted river channels.
